question: Gaumukh Kund is a reservoir located in which of the following forts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittorgarh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gaumukh Kund** is a sacred water body situated on the western part of the famous **Chittorgarh Fort. **
 
• 'Gaumukh' literally means the** 'mouth of a cow'.** The water flows through the cracks in the rocks and in due course, falls into the reservoir.
 
• The Chittorgarh Fort **is also known as** **Chittorgarh or Chittor Fort.**
 
• Chittorgarh Fort is the largest fort in India and Asia.
 
• It is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• The fort used to be the **capital of Mewar rulers.**
 
• It is **located in** the present-day town of **Chittorgarh in Rajasthan.**
 
• Built-in the 7th century AD, Chittorgarh Fort has withstood three major Muslim invasions starting from Alauddin Khilji in 1303, in 1535 by Bahadur Shah of Gujarat, and in 1568 by Akbar.

 
• It is situated on the bank of Berach river (Banas River tributary).
 
• Chittorgarh Fort has a total of seven gates and the main gate is named the Ram Pol.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Kumbhalgarh Fort:

 
 
• **Kumbhalgarh Fort** is located in the Rajsamand district of **Rajasthan.**
 
• Built by **Rana Kumbha **from the Sisodia Rajput dynasty.
 
• Longwall of the 36-kilometer length makes it the great wall of India.
 
• A special attraction in the fort is the Lakhola tank, Ganesh temple, and Parsvanatha temple.
 
• Kumbhalgarh is well known as the birthplace of Maharana Pratap.
 
 
 
• **Gwalior Fort**
 
 
• Gwalior Fort is known as Gibraltar of India.
 
• It was given the name ”The Perl in the necklace of the forts of Hind” by Mughal Emperor Babur.
 
• It was built in 525 AD century and it is one of the biggest forts in India.
 
• It was built by Suraj Sen.
 
• Temple Teli-ka-mandir is the most famous temple constructed in the Dravidian style of temple architecture.
 
 
 
• **Datia Mahal**
 
 
• Datia Mahal is a 7-storied architecture with two floors positioned in the basement.
 
• It is only made out of stone and bricks without any usage of wood or iron. So, the whole 7- storied building stands without any support of metal or even wood. 
 
• Datia Mahal is one of the great examples of Indo-Islamic architecture in India. A blend of Rajputana and Mughal styles gives it a luxurious look.
